**The Whispering Forest**

Deep in the heart of the Blackwoods, where the trees stood like ancient sentinels, there was a place called the Whispering Forest. It was said that the wind carried secrets through the leaves, and the roots of the oldest oaks remembered every footstep that ever passed through them.

I had heard the whispers for years, but I never believed them until the night I lost my way. The path had vanished into the mist, and the forest seemed to close in around me. Then, from the shadows, a voice—soft as a breeze—spoke my name.

*"You’re not alone."*

I turned, but there was no one there. Only the rustling of leaves and the distant call of an owl. Yet, I felt seen. The forest had guided me back to safety, as if it understood my fear.

Now, I visit the Whispering Forest often. I leave offerings of bread and flowers, and sometimes, when the wind is just right, I hear the whispers again. They’re not just words—they’re promises. The forest knows everything, and it’s always watching.

Maybe that’s why I keep coming back.
